This is incorrect. "Oedipus Tyrannus" is the Greek title for the play known in English as "Oedipus Rex" (or "Oedipus the King"), NOT "Oedipus at Colonus" (which is a different play by Sophocles, originally titled "Oedipus Koloneus"). This error would lead the WebSurfer to search for the wrong play and result in an incorrect final answer.
